description.content: Create, read, update, and convert Leads.

Return a paginated list of Leads. Supports filtering by `status` (new, contacted, qualified, unqualified, converted), `source`, `name`, `email`, `company_name`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Use `fields` to choose which public Lead fields appear in each record.

query.description: Maximum number of records to return.
Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.
Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.
Filter Leads by a partial, case-insensitive person name match.
Filter by an exact email address.
Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
Choose which public fields appear in each list record. Omit or pass a blank value for the default list fields, use `*` alone for every public detail field, or pass comma-separated names.
